subject: Proposal: Merge two morning enablement blocks into a single deep-dive
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@tallypay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Merge two morning enablement blocks into a single deep-dive

Hi Alex,

Quick note on the upcoming onboarding: I see we've been booked for two back-to-back 90-minute morning slots next Tuesday (console walkthrough at 9:00, API enablement at 11:00). To maximize continuity for your engineers and reduce context switching, would TallyPay be open to consolidating those into a single 3-hour deep-dive starting at 09:30?

Why I recommend this:
- Fewer handoffs = less re-intro overhead.
- We can structure it: 09:30–11:00 console (hands-on), 11:00–12:00 API patterns + workspace provisioning, 12:00–12:30 open Q&A and runbook review.

If that works, Ben will prepare a consolidated runbook and a short preflight checklist for your infra team. If not, we can keep the split blocks but I wanted to float this as an efficiency win.

From our side we need:
- Service account email for sandbox access (or confirmation you want us to create one).
- Any IP allowlist windows if your sandbox is behind a restricted firewall.

I've attached a short preflight checklist for your ops folks (preflight-checklist.pdf).

Thanks —
Neha
Director, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

Attachments: preflight-checklist.pdf
